scope: Bounded direct primary-source recheck after independent mathematical reconstruction; not an exhaustive priority audit, full-paper proof validation, or novelty certificate.

entries.format: official EMS full-PDF text through web tool
entries.read_scope: The complete Berger contribution at PDF pages 36-37 (zero-based), printed pages 2151-2152: model, Theorem 1, Conjecture 1, Remark 1, next-page proof discussion and martingale lemma.
entries.comparison: The report resamples the whole environment every step and uses iid nearest-neighbor ellipticity. In transverse dimension one this is the manuscript model. The stated coarse full-l1 endpoint probability for every diverging scale is superpolynomial; its following conjecture denies the one-dimensional assertion. The note proves the positive assertion for all fixed admissible laws, rather than relying on deterministic special cases.
entries.visual_limit: The web screenshot requests returned reference text without image pixels. I do not claim visual reading of the original report through those requests; direct primary full-PDF text was read.

entries.read_scope: Model (1.1)-(1.6), Theorem 1.1 and introduction comparison, Section 1.1 proof strategy. No full-paper proof audit.
entries.comparison: Continuum Gaussian velocity flow with independent molecular Brownian noise; quantitative L2 Gaussian-times-stationary-corrector theorem. Isolating a short final layer is explicit prior technique. The inspected statement does not supply the discrete all-law shrinking-cell full-l1 superpolynomial environmental tail.

entries.read_scope: Section 1.4, full Proposition 1.13, final-layer discussion (1.14)-(1.17), and Section 4.5 ordered-coalescing argument (4.37)-(4.40) and completion. Not a full-paper proof audit.
entries.comparison: Proposition 1.13 states a full-space beta one-point weak Gamma-corrected local limit for alpha,beta>0, alpha+beta>1/2. The final-layer discussion and ordered coalescing construction are real antecedents and deserve explicit credit. The manuscript gives that credit. No full anticipation of the manuscript quantifiers was established in these passages.

entries.read_scope: Definitions 1.10-1.12; complete two-regime Theorem 1.13 and adjacent critical-scale Remark 1.14; discussion of the Banach distribution topology; Section 1.7 item 8 on spatial averaging, Section 1.8 prior context. Not all 100-plus pages or technical proofs.
entries.comparison: A fluctuation-field limit in a distribution topology has a different observable and mode of convergence from arbitrary shrinking coarse-cell full-l1 with every inverse-power environmental probability bound. The inspected theorem does not itself state the latter. This is a logical scope comparison, not an exclusion of all stronger internal estimates.

entries.format: official Cambridge full-PDF text through web tool
entries.read_scope: Abstract/model introduction; Definition 1.4, full Theorem 1.5 on printed pp6-7, adjacent discussion, selected Remarks 1.6-1.8; Section 6.1 and complete Remark 6.2 on printed pp75-76. No complete 87-page proof audit or visual-reading claim.
entries.comparison: The main assertion is an SHE fluctuation limit in a Banach space of distributions with negative exponent, after moderate-deviation recentering/rescaling. Remark 6.2 explicitly remedies nearest-neighbor parity with two-step kernels on 2Z. The manuscript accurately avoids using parity to dismiss this framework. The inspected main statement does not supply the target full-l1 environmental tail.
